title: Telescopical
summary: TELESCOP'ICAL, a. Pertaining to a telescope; performed by a telescope; as a telescopic view. 1. Seen or discoverable only by a telescope; as telescopic stars.

inlines.v: TELESCOP'ICAL, a. Pertaining to a telescope; performed by a telescope; as a telescopic view. 1. Seen or discoverable only by a telescope; as telescopic stars.
